title: Slovakian Pork Paninis
description: A delicious Slovakian-inspired dish featuring tender pork and crunchy toast, all held together with the perfect balance of flavors.

ingredients.name: citrusy aioli
ingredients.notes: made with mayonnaise, lemon juice, and zest

ingredients.name: slovakian spices
ingredients.notes: such as caraway seeds or paprika

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the pork with Slovakian spices, salt, and pepper.
Grill the pork until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, toast the bread until crispy.
Spread a layer of citrusy aioli on each toasted bread slice.
Add sliced pork and top with quaint cheese.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
